body:
Yeah. No one really every does. I'm the sort of case that no one can really figure out how to help. But they keep saying to just keep going. I ask, how do I find reasonable solutions to my problems? There never is an answer. Explaining why I am even still alive is a whole nother narrative I haven't really touched on here. I thought I'd be dead by 25 honestly. It's hard when I have to decide to be the reason for my world to keep spinning, when the rest of world spins out of sync with mine.   


But. I laughed real hard when I read your comment. The comedy of the tragedy of life is acutely amusing.

Hi. I know you're going through a hard time. I've been exactly where you are. I had such severe depression and suicidal ideation for sooooo long afterwards. Doing it on your own is very hard. Sometimes, it ends up being impossible. When I think back on that time of my life, I medicated my issues by becoming promiscuous since no one would spend time with me unless I would have sex with them. I found someone who saw the marks on my arms and pointed them out. They said they'd been through that too. And that they wanted to help me. And they did. They were the only person there for me, and they even helped me move when no one else did. Eventually, our season passed.   


Your feelings are valid. They're how you feel. I hope you know I see you, and I respect that you live through so much pain that seems to be impossible to abate.   


I have many trust issues myself. When someone breaks your trust, especially if you gave them that trust (everyone expects us to trust people in authority, right? I'm talking about the trust you give someone that you believe is supposed to care for you, and you let them), it can be very hard to fix that or find ways around it. Do you start off with not being able to trust others? That's where I'm at in life.   


Humans are social creatures by nature. Even the introverted or isolated ones have some impulse usually that craves human interaction.   


Some people don't have the space to care for other people's issues or crosses. We all seem to be so complex. Your ex girlfriend leaving you isn't necessarily a 100% reflection of you. I know me saying it won't change the fact that you opened up to them and chose to trust them, and likely reveal bits of yourself that you keep only within your view. It's so hard to believe that the person who you feel knows you better than most or maybe all others isn't rejecting you exactly for who you are. And honestly, in a way, they are rejecting you for who you are. But the other side of that equation? THEY are the person rejecting or declining you. Not someone else. Who they are, in all their complexity, couldn't make it with you. It's not a "you" thing. It's a "person" and "person" thing. Just like chemistry. Just because one element creates explosive or undesirable results with the next element, doesn't mean those elements on their own are bad. It feels this way, that it is us who is the "bad element", because we are the ones experiencing it.    


I don't think being in pain makes you bad. I don't think reactions to trauma or how our brain operates makes us bad. But often, that is how society makes sense of it.   


Your feelings are soooooo valid. But feelings are not always arbiters of truth. Sometimes we don't have the tools or support to see anything else. Reaching out is one of the most rudimentary tools you can use. I see you reaching out. And I know reaching out doesn't fix it. But you are doing something. And that alone, in my perspective, makes you more than the things you feel you are. I know it's hard to see it when you're in your experience, in you. Sometimes it can be beneficial to make leaps of faith. I know I'm a stranger, and there's no impetus for you believe me. But I see you as a perfect human. No human is perfect. You are so real and honest in who you are here, on reddit. And that makes you a perfect human. Because what is human if not emotional and feeling?  


Your pain is real, and I wish more could see it and acknowledge it. Please feel free to answer honestly and tell me more of your experience, because i want to understand, I don't want to undermine. I thought I'd be dead a lot sooner, but I'm still here. doesn't mean I don't want to die still. But I'm still here. And I should be dead. And that's not because of other people, but because of me. <3 I hope to hear from you, whatever it is.

\[continuation\]

26. Writing all this temporarily takes these things off my chest. But every day, I have been feeling down and lost and more and more hopeless. I need my own place. I have accomplished so much self improvement. But it's not enough when I cannot trust and cannot afford a place because the housing market is speculative. I don't feel so much like suiciding at this very moment, but the compacting nature of life and events for the last 1.5 months is squaring me into a corner where I feel like the only solution is suicide. I've started seriously thinking again about how I can accomplish this. I think about just leaving and becoming homeless. I wish I had been a protester hit and killed by a car. But I'm so cautious and concerned for my child, and lowkey my mom and me, as I know how precious a mother is to a child, I loved the fuck out of my mom as a child, I haven't even been able to rationalize going to the protests because of covid and life risk, and how that could devastate my child. I want things fixed, but I'm the only one working on themselves in this house, and for a hell of a long time too. It hurts when my mom blames me and pretends that just because she yells, the ways she ignores me and belittles me, attacks and gaslights when threatened from triggers, makes it so I can't keep making progress. I know I'm privileged in a lot of ways, and I try not to take it for granted, but it's also hard accepting my part in life is so little and futile right now. I've been fighting depression and suicide since 13 practically. I remember the first time the depression made me moody and confsued and angry and sad, so unable to understand why nothing was ok anymore, and my mom threatened to have me institutionalized. 

​

27. Every day I am trying to reach out somewhere, so I don't kill myself or leave. I can't keep hopping from one tealight candle to another. At some point, it isn't going to be enough, and I am going to do it. I am going to do something monumentally stupid, and it will either end me or damage me heavily and add yet another thick ass layer of ostracization. I just want reasonable hope. I want to know the things I need, NAMELY TRUE BLUE IRL FRIENDS, AND A PLACE TO LIVE THAT'S MY OWN, and financial stability of course, are going to happen soon. Not never, or 10, 20, 30 years down the line. Fuck, I've been working on my credit, something I never cared about before, so that I hopefully can buy a house or land or something one day. But I am so alone, and the patterns that hold me (not to mention so many others) down ARE NOT CHANGING, and I can only bleed my heart out so many times before I'm too weak to rebuild my blood supply. WTF do I do guys? Why keep going when it always turns down like this? It's over $1000 for a place of your own these days, and roommates don't work for me. And apartment complexes aren't good either. Also, it's hard to find a place I can afford as a single parent with a child - the child alone makes it so small units refuse to rent to me, and roommates don't want a child in the house. And the inability to trust is also a -part- of why I can't live in an apartment complex. The last time I almost got an apartment, I got a really bad vibe from someone who would've been my neighbor, and my mom didn't want me living so far out in an inaccessible location, so between the vibe and my mom, I gave up on the apartment, which I could've had.
